name: @borgar/simple-xml
description: A reasonably fast, simple and pure-JS XML parser with no dependencies

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.docs: typedoc && concat-md tempdocs > API.md && rm -rf tempdocs
scripts.build: npm run build:dist && npm run docs && echo 'Success!'
scripts.release: git diff --exit-code && PACKAGE_VERSION=$(jq -r .version package.json) && echo "About to tag and push v$PACKAGE_VERSION. Continue? (y/n)" && read -r REPLY && [ "$REPLY" = "y" ] && git tag --annotate v$PACKAGE_VERSION --message=v$PACKAGE_VERSION && git push origin v$PACKAGE_VERSION

author: Borgar Þorsteinsson <borgar@borgar.net> (http://borgar.net/)
